xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4253: Effort survives relaunch: persist effort on AgentState and re-apply it on resume, recovery, rotation and crash respawn

plan.title: Effort survives relaunch: persist effort on AgentState and re-apply it on resume, recovery, rotation and crash respawn
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: AgentState has no effort field, so `pan start --effort max` launches the first session at max but every relaunch (resume, restart, recovery, messaging fallback, session rotation, crash respawn, cloister model handoff) rebuilds the launcher without an effort and the agent comes back at the role-file frontmatter value (high). The claude-code runtime adapter also ignores SpawnConfig.effort.
narratives.Proposal: Persist effort and effortSource on AgentState (whitelisted in cleanAgentState) at spawn from what the caller supplied. Add one helper, resolveRelaunchEffort (src/lib/agents/relaunch-effort.ts): a persisted effort wins and is re-clamped through resolveEffort; legacy state resolves through resolveEffort's role/project/default chain. Every relaunch path calls it, passes the effort to the launcher, and writes it back. Fix the claude-code resume branch of buildAgentLaunchConfig to emit opts.effort, narrow SpawnConfig.effort to EffortLevel with an effortSource, and have the claude-code adapter forward both. Document the behavior in configuration/effort.mdx. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4253.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to what effort a fresh spawnRun/spawnAgent launches with when the caller passes none (S4 PAN-4256, S5 PAN-4257)
- No config re-read at relaunch for agents with a persisted effort; config changes reach new spawns only
- No restoration of a pre-clamp request after a model switch
- No effort display in dashboard, pan status/show, cost ledger or sessions.json (S7 PAN-4259)
- No conversation-runtime or live /effort changes (S2 PAN-4254, S3 PAN-4255)
- No removal of per-harness adapter fallbacks (S8 PAN-4260)
- No fix for cleanAgentState dropping foreman/modelSpawnKey/workspaceId (PAN-4487)
- No subRole threading into recoverAgent's getRoleRuntimeBaseCommand call
- No xhigh or max default anywhere

autoDecisions.summary: Pin rule: a persisted state.effort wins at every relaunch whatever its source; config is not re-read for that agent.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors restartAgent keeping agentState.model unless told otherwise; the issue asks to re-launch 'with it'. Config changes reach new spawns only (recorded as a NonGoal).

autoDecisions.summary: Re-clamp the persisted level to the relaunch model/harness and store the clamped level; carry effortSource forward unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: resolveEffort clamps explicit values already; storing what actually launched keeps state truthful for S7 display.

autoDecisions.summary: Legacy state without effort resolves through resolveEffort({role, subRole, issueId, model, harness}) and is written back after the first relaunch.
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue AC: legacy state resolves through resolveEffort as before; write-back makes state describe the most recent launch.

autoDecisions.summary: spawnAgent/spawnRun persist only the effort the caller supplied (source defaults to 'explicit'); they do not start resolving effort themselves.
autoDecisions.rationale: Making role, slot and dashboard callers resolve effort is S4 (PAN-4256) and S5 (PAN-4257); avoids overlapping their diffs.

autoDecisions.summary: Narrow SpawnConfig.effort from string to EffortLevel and add effortSource.
autoDecisions.rationale: Only two producers exist and all consumers accept string, so the narrowing compiles and removes the need for a runtime guard.

autoDecisions.summary: Include cloister model handoff (handoff.ts:145) although the §2 audit omitted it.
autoDecisions.rationale: It is a kill-and-respawn of the same agent id that drops effort the same way; one call site, fits the 25-file surface budget.

autoDecisions.summary: Clamp warnings on relaunch go to logAgentLifecycle, not stderr.
autoDecisions.rationale: Relaunch paths are dashboard-reachable server code.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not fix cleanAgentState dropping foreman/modelSpawnKey/workspaceId; filed as #4487.

items.title: AgentState persists effort and effortSource through cleanAgentState

narrative.Action: PRD W1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4253.md). Add `effort?: EffortLevel` and `effortSource?: EffortSource` to `export interface AgentState` after `modelSpawnKey` and add both fields to `cleanAgentState`, each guarded by `isEffortLevel(raw.effort)` (D8; no EffortSource list copy). Without the cleanAgentState entries the fields are silently dropped on every save and read. Write the three round-trip tests listed in W1.

narrative.Action: PRD W2. Create src/lib/agents/relaunch-effort.ts with the exact code in W2: resolveRelaunchEffort(state, {model, harness, config}) applies the pin rule (persisted effort wins, re-clamped via resolveEffort explicit, source carried forward, defaulting to 'explicit'), and legacy state falls back to resolveEffort({role, subRole: reviewSubRole, issueId, model, harness}). spawnEffortFields(effort, source) returns {} when effort is undefined. Import AgentState as `import type` from ./agent-state-read.js. Never write `effort ?? 'high'`. Write the six W2 test cases with an explicit EffortConfigSlice.
